sentences.A: Among large social-tariff households with past late payments (profile A), bills on autopay were late about 48 percentage points less often than bills without it (95% interval 46 to 49 points), a comparison of households that chose differently.
sentences.B: Among four-person standard households with no late payments (profile B), bills on autopay were late about 17 percentage points less often than bills without it (95% interval 17 to 18 points), a comparison of households that chose differently.
sentences.C: Among small villa households with large bills (profile C), bills on autopay were late about 41 percentage points less often than bills without it (95% interval 39 to 42 points), a comparison of households that chose differently.
